en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the courtyard of a modernist school building with large rectangular windows and a rounded glass stairwell or bay on the facade. In the landscaped yard there are benches where several people sit. Prominently in the foreground stands a bust of a man on a tall stone pedestal. Text in Swedish is printed in the lower left and right corners.
